description: This file defines the DataTransform class with methods for sanitizing and processing data records in the vtiger CRM system, including handling references, owner fields, date, and currency fields.

classes.name: DataTransform
classes.description: A utility class for sanitizing and transforming data records within vtiger CRM, including reference resolution, owner assignment, and date/currency formatting.

methods.name: sanitizeDataWithColumn
methods.description: Sanitizes a data row by mapping columns to fields and applying general sanitization.

methods.name: sanitizeDataWithCountColumn
methods.description: Handles sanitization for count(*) columns, returning a count value.

methods.name: filterAndSanitize
methods.description: Filters columns and sanitizes data for a record.

methods.name: sanitizeData
methods.description: Performs reference, owner, and field sanitization on a data row.

methods.name: sanitizeForInsert
methods.description: Prepares a data row for insertion, handling special cases for emails, events, calendar, and setting reminder times.

methods.name: filterAllColumns
methods.description: Filters a row to include only known fields based on metadata.

methods.name: sanitizeFields
methods.description: Sanitizes individual fields, including ID formatting and HTML entity decoding.

methods.name: sanitizeReferences
methods.description: Resolves reference fields to valid IDs, handling related entity existence.

methods.name: sanitizeOwnerFields
methods.description: Converts owner fields to proper ID format.

methods.name: sanitizeDateFieldsForInsert
methods.description: Formats date fields for insertion based on current user preferences.

methods.name: sanitizeCurrencyFieldsForInsert
methods.description: Converts currency fields to user format for insertion.
